introduction.title: 能力介绍
introduction.body: 连接你的 Figma 帐号，让 AI 可以读取你的设计稿、组件、样式与注释，帮助你进行设计分析、提取信息或生成建议。

showcase.userPrompt: 帮我分析这个页面的设计规范
showcase.assistantReply: 好的，以下是对该页面的设计分析…

features.title: 主要功能
items: 读取文件、页面、组件与样式
提取颜色、字体与间距等设计标注
生成设计分析与优化建议
支持 FigJam 内容解析（白板）

quotes: 设计分析太准了，节省了我很多时间！
能够直接从设计稿提取信息，太方便了。

introduction.title: About
introduction.body: Connect your Figma account so the AI can read design files, components, styles, and comments—then help analyze designs, extract specs, or suggest improvements.

showcase.userPrompt: Help me analyze the design system on this page
showcase.assistantReply: Sure — here’s an analysis of this page…

features.title: Key features
items: Read files, pages, components, and styles
Extract colors, type, and spacing specs
Generate design analysis and improvement ideas

reviews.title: Reviews
quotes: Design analysis is spot on and saves me a lot of time.
Pulling specs straight from the file is so convenient.
Collaboration with the team leveled up.
